Access common and format-specific extraction metadata

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/html\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/html/simple_table.html\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].metadata)
    print(((result.results[0].metadata.format.html.title if result.results[0].metadata.format.html else None) if result.results[0].metadata.format else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
